content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.information: Office of Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Sonapur - Gadchiroli

content_sections.heading: About College of Agriculture Gadchiroli
content_sections.text: College of Agriculture, Sonapur, Gadchiroli is in Gadchiroli district and comes under Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola. This notice was issued by its Associate Dean.

content_sections.heading: College of Agriculture Gadchiroli Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Pay is Rs.1000/- per theory class and Rs.2000/- per practical class. The notice sets one theory and two practical classes per week, for a total of Rs. 5000/- per week. The opening paragraph of the notice calls the third post NSS/Physical Education, while its post table says Physical Education. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: College of Agriculture Gadchiroli Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The job is for only one semester. The person appointed teaches the respective subject, conducts the examination and submits the result.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview at the college.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The term of appointment is co-terminus with the filling of permanent regular posts, the completion of tenure or the performance of the candidate, whichever is earlier. The consent letter stands terminated after 06 months from the date of appointment. No accommodation will be provided.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for College of Agriculture Gadchiroli Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you hold the essential qualification for the post you want. Collect your original documents and prepare self-attested copies of all of them. Report to the Associate Dean's office at the time and date given in the overview table. Submit and bring the documents listed below. Documents to submit and bring: Documents pertaining to date of birth Educational qualification documents Experience certificate, if any NET/SET exam documents, if passed Caste Certificate, Caste Validity and non-creamy layer certificate Any other relevant document concerning your claim

faq.question: Q1. Is NET/SET or a Ph.D. compulsory for these posts?
faq.answer: No. NET/SET or a Ph.D. is preferred. The essential qualifications are M.Sc. Mathematics, M.Sc. Statistics and M. P. Ed. for the respective posts.

faq.question: Q2. How is the Rs.20,000/- monthly pay worked out?
faq.answer: One theory class at Rs.1000/- and two practical classes at Rs.2000/- each make Rs. 5000/- per week, which the notice states as Rs.20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. Can this contract job become a regular post?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, and the person appointed shall not have any claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q4. Will candidates get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. How long does a selected candidate have to join?
faq.answer: The selected candidate must join physically at the office within seven days from the date of issue of the consent order. If not, the order is treated as cancelled.

faq.question: Q6. What must reserved-category candidates bring?
faq.answer: The notice lists the Caste Certificate, Caste Validity and non-creamy layer certificate among the documents to submit and bring.
